name: online-search-benchmark
description: Benchmark for evaluating models' ability to answer information-seeking queries that require online search or knowledge retrieval from web-style content. Measures correctness and relevance of retrieved information and generated answers across a variety of real-world query types. Designed to test retrieval-aware reasoning, factual grounding, and resistance to hallucination when external knowledge is required.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest community use for evaluating retrieval-aware QA and search-integration capabilities.
